title: manihot pentaphylla var. paviifolia
intro: Manihot pentaphylla var. paviifolia, commonly known as the wild cassava or piai, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a shrub native to the tropical forests of Central and South America, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions such as fever, pain, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Manihot pentaphylla var. paviifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
